description: This file defines the 'Tracing' class, which manages tracing operations such as starting, stopping, grouping, and collecting stack traces within the Playwright core library. It interacts with channels, artifacts, and connection utilities to handle trace data.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: Represents a tracing controller that manages start, stop, grouping, and stack collection for tracing sessions within Playwright.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Tracing instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Tracing instance with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new tracing session with optional parameters like name, title, snapshots, screenshots, sources, and live mode.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Starts a new trace chunk with optional name and title.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group, optionally with a source file location.

methods.name: _startCollectingStacks
methods.description: Begins collecting stack traces, setting internal state and retrieving stack IDs.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally saving to a specified file path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracing session and finalizes trace data, optionally saving to a file.

methods.name: _doStopChunk
methods.description: Handles the logic for stopping a trace chunk, saving or discarding data as needed.

methods.name: _resetStackCounter
methods.description: Resets internal tracing state and stack collection flags.
